payload_accounting.status: arithmetic cross-check; complete BurnNand consumption not replayed
notes: Rounded to 256 sectors per update chunk, not a claim about physical NAND block geometry.
Resource A stream begins 0x200 before embedded E04. Header fields with AD padding are not interpreted as installed-media values.

observations: Original supplied burn header hash flag is 0. The card callback then performs two reads and compares their actual lengths and bytes, with at most two attempts.
Flag 1 appends a 16-byte digest to the requested read and invokes the hash worker. Replay models the worker result.
Protection is a loader policy on numeric sections: ID3 uses header_mode==1 and handle_protect==1; ID6 uses header_mode==1 and payload==0; other IDs use span!=0 and payload==0.
Original incoming header has update/existing-map low byte 1. Map generation consumes the installed header as a separate input, checks compatibility and preserves installed values.
The actual BurnNand prefix was executed to the return site after native BurnGetSectionsMap with a synthetic existing header and geometry.

burn_nand_prefix.scope: Original BurnNand prologue, real original payload header, native BurnGetSectionsMap and protection helpers. Stop immediately after map return, before flash operations.

limits: Synthetic FileX status and actual-count results; no physical SD/NAND access.
MD5 worker outcomes are modeled. These cases prove callback handling, not cryptographic digest computation.
Two equal short or zero-length successful reads return 1 in this callback alone. This is not proof that a truncated update can pass later stages.
Protection fields retain numeric section IDs until caller/header semantics are separately established. Pointer helper index 7 computes an address but does not prove a valid eighth section.
Map cases use the original incoming boot header with synthetic installed-media header and NAND geometry, not a camera dump.
The BurnNand prefix models its card read with original input bytes and existing-media reads/geometry; no storage operation or full loader loop was executed.

notes: K-3 III update validation uses project/type/magic and word sums in a different format; the Q7 E01 map/protection rules are not transferred to it.
Both projects distinguish capability input, command admission and completion. The K-3 III AF command/dispatch evidence does not establish Q7 group2/op4 wire semantics or actuator compatibility.
